{{Top}}
'''Keratin''' was a substance that could be found in the physiology of various [[Species/Legends|species]]. The [[Gand/Legends|Gands]] had a layer of transparent keratin that served to shield their [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] from airborne debris, such as would be present in a [[Sandstorm/Legends|sandstorm]]. The scales of the [[Barabel/Legends|Barabel]]<ref name="GG4-1">''[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races]]''</ref> and ends of [[Anzat/Legends|Anzats']] feeding tendrils<ref name="Crosscurrent">''[[Crosscurrent]]''</ref> were comprised of keratin.
